tasks.title: Airspeed from differential pressure
tasks.solution: V = pitot_scale × √(2 × |ΔP| / 1.225). The density 1.225 kg/m³ is hard-coded (SSL_AIR_DENSITY), and there is no altitude correction. For 245 Pa and a scale of 1.0: √(490 / 1.225) = 20.0 m/s. The scale is in front of the root: 1.08 gives 21.6 m/s, not 20.8.

tasks.title: Rangefinder altitude with tilt compensation
tasks.solution: cos θ = cos(roll) × cos(pitch); altitude = distance × cos θ, with the fractional part dropped. For 150 cm, 8° and 6°: 150 × 0.9903 × 0.9945 = 147.7 → 147 cm. The largest tilt in the problem is 34.8° (25° and 25°), which is less than 45°, so the reading is not discarded. The estimator then compares the result with inav_max_surface_altitude.

tasks.title: Velocity from optical flow
tasks.solution: Flow in °/s = count × (10⁶ / Δt) / opflow_scale; with Δt = 100 ms the factor is 10. Subtract the body rotation, convert to radians and multiply by the altitude: V = (flow − gyro) × π / 180 × h. For a count of 30, a scale of 9.535, 5 °/s and 80 cm: 31.46 − 5 = 26.46 °/s = 0.4618 rad/s, V = 36.9 cm/s.

tasks.title: A temperature threshold in CLI units
tasks.solution: The thresholds of temp_sensor and osd_*_temp_alarm_* are set in tenths of a degree Celsius, with a range from −550 to 1250. 85 °C = 850. The number 85 in this field means 8.5 °C — the element would blink all the time.
